title: The Horn of Jurgen Windcaller
description: Arngeir sends the Dragonborn on a final trial to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav. Upon arrival the Horn is missing, replaced by a note from Delphine requesting a meeting at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood. After meeting Delphine and recovering the Horn, the Dragonborn returns to High Hrothgar, learns the final word of Unrelenting Force from Wulfgar, and receives the Greybeards' formal recognition as Dragonborn.

base_facts: I am the eldest of the Greybeards and speak for our order.
I have sent the Dragonborn to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav as a final trial.
The Horn is named after Jurgen Windcaller, the founder of the Greybeards.

RETURN_HORN: The Dragonborn has returned with the Horn and proven worthy of the trial.
QUEST_COMPLETE: The Dragonborn has returned the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller and completed the final trial I set for them.
The Greybeards have formally recognized the Dragonborn, speaking our greeting in the dragon language all at once.
High Hrothgar is now fully open to the Dragonborn; they may freely take what they need from within.
My disposition toward the Dragonborn has increased for their success in this trial.

base_facts: I am one of the Greybeards.
I will teach the final word of Unrelenting Force once the Dragonborn completes their trial.

GREYBEARDS_RECOGNITION: I have taught the Dragonborn the final word of Unrelenting Force.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I have taught the Dragonborn the final word of Unrelenting Force, completing their knowledge of the shout.
I joined my fellow Greybeards in speaking the formal recognition of the Dragonborn in the dragon language.

base_facts: I run the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood.
I took the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav to get the Dragonborn's attention.

MEET_DELPHINE: I have revealed myself to the Dragonborn and returned the Horn.
My organization has been looking for someone like the Dragonborn.
QUEST_COMPLETE: I returned the Horn to the Dragonborn and revealed my purpose; my organization has found the one we seek.
I await the Dragonborn in Riverwood to pursue the matter of A Blade in the Dark.

beats.comment: Arngeir assigns the final trial to retrieve the Horn of Jurgen Windcaller from Ustengrav.
Player discovers the Horn is missing and finds a mysterious note on the pedestal.
Player meets Delphine at the Sleeping Giant Inn in Riverwood and receives the Horn.
Player returns the Horn to Arngeir at High Hrothgar, completing the trial.
Wulfgar teaches the final word of Unrelenting Force and the Greybeards formally recognize the Dragonborn.
Quest complete. The Dragonborn is formally recognized and High Hrothgar is fully open.
